reviews.title: Good fans but finicky connections
reviews.comment: These fans look great and work well but one thing I learned is that if the fans arent connected to the connections cables in a specific way, they wouldn't work. One orientation only. Other than that, great fans.
reviews.author: Garrett

reviews.title: Good looking, easy clean wireing.
reviews.comment: Love the Magnetic cable attachment and the ability to series connect adjacent fans with out need for wires.
reviews.author: Dean Craig

reviews.title: Cut wire
reviews.comment: Great set of fans.  Lucked out by getting two sets.  Fan daisy chain was cut, so had to use the one from the other set to complete the build.
reviews.author: Pete L

reviews.title: Not correct fan rpm speed
reviews.comment: They work great and have amazing color. The only downside is that they only go up to 1850 rpm but the description says they can go up to 2200 rpm.
reviews.author: Ethan Grabovac

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.comment: Love these, so far. Installing fans has never been so easy and self-explanatory as these. Magnetically snap them together. Magnetically attach cables. Plug in. I added these to the bottom of my gaming case to add extra air pressure and flow within. Synced them to the existing argb chasis fans and system fans lighting and with an overclocked system these were a great investment. They look so much like the chasis fans and fans that came with my Peerless Assassin 120 dual tower cpu Heatsink that I had to give them a chance. Definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Brandon Pierce
